external_rss_boundary: Batch sizing uses query-account capacity, shared retained-result bytes, governor memory availability and the hard process-policy resident ceiling. No blanket liveness guarantee under stable externally owned RSS is claimed; an open cursor may require host pressure/sample/reservation changes before retry can progress. Smaller batch options can be selected at cursor construction; open-cursor options remain captured. Sampled RSS pressure is not reclassified as a permanent self-owned sizing failure.
